cards.title: Quebec Separatist Party Wins Election, Forms Minority Government

sentences.text: The party, led by Paul St-Pierre Plamondon, was on track to win nearly 60 of the 127 seats in Quebec’s National Assembly, falling short of the 64 needed for a majority.
